businesses.business: Luxury apparel and home goods retail

offering_description.value: It sells luxury ready-to-wear clothing, shoes, accessories and home goods to consumers, with apparel collections for women and men. Shoppers can buy its collections through its website.

quotes.quote: Understated luxury from California. Shop new arrivals featuring cashmere, knitwear, leather & shoes for women and men.

Quiet sophistication is found in our foundational heroes, which move through spaces, seasons, occasions, and phases of one’s life with ease. Spirited standouts are distinguished by texture, color, and pattern. Since our founding every addition to our women’s and men’s ready-to-wear, accessories and home collection is crafted to inspire a timeless confidence, allowing one to think more clearly and creatively — the truest luxury. This is Vince.
